name: Holding-period return
meaning: Total return earned over one holding period.
commonMistake: Omitting income or dividing by ending value.

name: Price return
meaning: Return from the change in market price only.
commonMistake: Including dividends when only price return is requested.

name: Income return
meaning: Income received relative to beginning value.
workedExample: A 4 dividend on a 100 beginning price is 4%.
commonMistake: Using ending price as the denominator.

name: Exact real return
meaning: Purchasing-power growth after removing inflation exactly.
commonMistake: Subtracting inflation when an exact result is required.

name: Approximate real return
meaning: A quick approximation of purchasing-power growth.

name: Arithmetic mean return
commonMistake: Using it to report compound growth.

name: Geometric mean return
meaning: Constant periodic rate matching compounded wealth growth.
commonMistake: Averaging percentages rather than wealth relatives.

name: Time-weighted return
meaning: Compounded performance after neutralizing external cash-flow timing.

name: Foreign-currency investment return
meaning: Domestic return combining local asset and exchange-rate effects.

variables.Rcurrency: foreign currency return versus domestic currency

commonMistake: Simply adding the two returns and losing the interaction term.
